$comment: Owner rule 2026-11-17: the weekly autopilot prepares next week's videos and schedules each one on its own calendar date without asking the owner. Runbook: content/WORKFLOW.md#weekly-autopilot. Helper: scripts/weekly-autopilot.mjs. This is the ONE owner-authorized exception to per-video preview approval; every other route keeps it.
ownerWords: хар хафта якшабакуни соат 14:02 да … агенти бирхафталик видеони олдиндан таёрлаб барчасини уз санасига ва бир кулай вахтни танлап режалаштирип кояди мени тастик бошка суралмайди. … Йикилса тузатиб каета уринснсин то утмагунча.

run.runner: scheduled task on the owner's Mac (owner choice 2026-11-17: keys, VPN and Remotion are local)
run.coversWeek: the next Monday through Sunday in calendar.json, every content type, every default production language

approval.scope: Only videos produced by this weekly run that pass every automated gate below. The run records the owner's standing approval with the exact video and post hashes it published; it never covers a manual or other route.
requiredGates: complete source draft in every language (content:buffer), with the active experiment arm (content:experiments -- --check)
lesson-art frames generated, automatically reviewed AND looked at and confirmed (content:art:review)
registered CTA and verified kept CTA voice
Gemini voice with STT-verified word timestamps (never guessed)
cue timeline, render gates and node scripts/mix-check.mjs pass
the agent looked at cue frames of every final MP4 (EDITING_SPEC.md#review-before-delivery)

publishTimes.rule: One post per account per day, on the item's own calendar date. Default 16:00 in the audience's local time; the agent may choose another time only with sourced Zernio evidence written in its report.
publishTimes.manualPlatforms: Platforms with zernioPublishingAuthorized false in publication-destinations.json (RU Facebook) are left for the owner and listed in the report.

retry.rule: When a gate fails, diagnose the root cause, fix it and retry until it passes (owner 2026-11-17). Free steps (STT resume, re-render, source fixes, meaning visuals) retry without limit inside the run.
retry.rateLimits: Owner 2026-11-17: when the Gemini (free-tier) quota is exhausted (HTTP 429), switch TTS/STT to the approved OpenRouter transport (HSK_AI_OPENROUTER_FALLBACK_ENABLED=true + OPENROUTER_API_KEY; the voice script does this itself) on the SAME saved speech. Only if OpenRouter also cannot verify the words, wait for the Gemini quota reset and --resume the kept take. Never rotate Google keys, never mix TTS providers inside a saved take, never accept unverified words.
retry.afterCaps: Leave that one video unscheduled, keep every paid artifact, continue with the others and name the blocker in the report.
retry.openRouterOwnerWords: гемини бупул тугаса опен роутердан фойдалансин.
retry.listenedSpans: Owner 2026-11-17 ("шу ёзган вахтини олип сен хитойчага угирсангчи" → "тугри 2 ласихам"): when the only unverified words are Mandarin that the recognizer wrote as a translation or homophone, the provider's own word edges may carry the source words ONLY after the owner listens to that exact clip and confirms it (review/<id>/<take>/owner-span-exceptions.json, scripts/owner-span-exception.mjs). The autopilot never writes that file itself: it cuts the clips into review/<id>/listen-check/, sends them to the owner, leaves that video unscheduled and continues with the others.

report.contents: per date and language: content ID, experiment arm, gates, scheduled platforms with Zernio post IDs and times, manual platforms, blockers and money spent
report.commit: Commit and push the week's source fixes, frames, CTA/voice library, ledger and report to main.
